description:
Outcome: The coordinator maintains reliable household and season records for allocations, from brief.md §Background, §Users and §Rules.
Scope: Exactly 40 plots, households and memberships, coordinator role, prior-season holdings, season dates/timezone; verified manual entry from garden records; coordinator enrollment/invitation initiation and duplicate-household reconciliation. Give unregistered gardeners a plain-language route to contact the coordinator.
Excludes: Applications, allocation workflows and whole-garden holder map/dashboard.
Acceptance: Exactly 40 distinct valid plots; members linked to verified households; prior holdings recorded; incomplete/duplicate households flagged for reconciliation. Coordinator independently verifies membership before registering an invited email. Season dates are in March–October and the Feb 1 cutoff uses the configured garden timezone.
Behaviour: Invalid records rejected without partial writes; contacts accessible only to coordinator; enrollment errors explain how to seek help.
Verification: Registry validation, persistence and authorization tests with synthetic records; duplicate reconciliation and previously unregistered gardener enrollment scenarios.
Prerequisites: T-001.
Assumptions: Coordinator verifies household identity and paper prior holdings, not email equality alone; exact season dates and local timezone supplied before launch.
title: Register plots, seasons, households and verified enrollment
